The engine has been upgraded from Unity 2022.3.33f1 to Unity 2022.3.62f2.
This update addresses the Unity CVE-2025-59489 security vulnerability to prevent potential exploits and improve overall stability and security.
About Community Mod Compatibility
Due to the major engine update, some community-made mods built for older versions may no longer be compatible.
If you wish to continue using mods that only work with the previous stable version, please follow this guide:
Branch Switching Guide

releases.displayName: Nine Sols Prequel Manga Update - Nine Sols: The Way of Lear – Prelude Part 3

items.text: Hi, this is Red Candle Games.
The third chapter of Nine Sols – The Way of Lear: Prelude is now live. As the final installment of the series, we warmly invite you to read and experience the conclusion.
Once again, our heartfelt thanks to everyone involved in the making of this work—especially MOJOIN and artist Yang Chi-Cheng—for devoting over a year of effort to bring the character of Lear to life!
✴︎ Nine Sols - The Way of Lear: Prelude Part 3

We're excited to announce that Nine Sols is now fully localized in six new languages:
German, French, LATAM Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Ukrainian.

Kudos to our amazing translators for bringing the game to life in these languages. Thanks to their incredible work, even more players can dive deep into the story and experience the game like never before!
To celebrate this milestone, Nine Sols will be featured in an upcoming Steam Midweek Madness sale. Details will be announced later today, so stay tuned!
